The '''''Quasar Fire''-class cruiser-carrier''', also referred to as the '''''Quasar Fire''-class bulk cruiser''' or '''Alliance escort carrier''', was a modular [[Starship/Legends|starship]] typically used for [[Freighter/Legends|freight]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Flurry_egvv.jpg|thumb|left|150px|''Flurry'' schematics]]
Designed by the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] megacorporation [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub]], the ''Quasar Fire''-class [[Bulk cruiser/Legends|bulk cruiser]] resembled a triangle, with the bridge at the frontal point and the cargo bay at the base. The cargo bay could be modified to house various freight modules or, in some cases, passenger modules.

They were armed with two forward [[Turbolaser/Legends|light turbolaser]] batteries.<ref name="Target" />

Thin armor and [[Deflector shield/Legends|shielding]] ran the 350-meter length of the ''Quasar Fire'' class, and while the stock model featured no weapons, freight companies and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] often added [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser]] or [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] cannons. A typical crew for this ship ran around 250 personnel.

==History==
Although they were designed as cargo freighters, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] saw them as a relatively easy way to transport starfighters to an engagement and support them with full-service hangars close to the site of the battle. The Rebels acquired some of the freighters at auction and then took them to secret Rebel [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]], where they were stripped down and rebuilt into starfighter carriers over several [[Standard month/Legends|months]].<ref name="Target" /> After modification, they could carry 48 starfighters each (four squadrons), which was an improvement over the other carriers in the Alliance fleet, [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruisers]] and [[Neutron Star-class bulk cruiser/Legends|''Neutron Star''-class bulk cruisers]], which could only hold 36.<ref name="Bakura Sourcebook" />

When the Sullustans joined the war shortly before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], they donated eight ''Quasar Fire''-class ships to the Alliance, who then gave them to the [[Virgillian Free Alignment/Legends|Virgillian Free Alignment]], who were fighting against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]-allied [[Aristocracy]] in the [[Virgillian Civil War]]. The Virgillians modified the ships even further with Imperial technology, improving the sensors, shields, weapons and computers of four of their eight cruiser-carriers. The ships were instrumental in the Virgillian Free Alignment victory just before the Battle of Endor,<ref name="Bakura Sourcebook" /> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Due to significant damage sustained during the last battles of the war, the Free Alignment were only able to send two of their cruiser-carriers to fight in the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], including their flagship the ''[[Flurry]]'' captained by [[Tessa Manchisco]]. The ''[[Flurry]]'' then went on to participate in the [[Invasion of Bakura|relief mission]] to [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]], but was destroyed by the Imperial frigate ''[[Dominant]]'' during the battle.

Due to their efficiency and fragility, ''Quasar Fire''-class cruiser were accompanied by their own battlegroup. They were scattered across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and only brought together when the Alliance needed a large concentration of starfighters.By the time of the Battle of Yavin, the Alliance had lost two of the original ships, although many still remained active.<ref name="Target" />

The ''Quasar Fire''-class ship ''[[Battle Dog]]'' was part of Group Two of the [[Solo Fleet]] during the hunt for [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]] in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], under the command of Captain [[Geng Salaban]].<ref name="Solo Command">''[[X-Wing: Solo Command]]''</ref>

A ''Quasar Fire''-class cruiser named the ''[[Thurse]]'' served at a [[Battle of Bilbringi (Yuuzhan Vong War)|battle]] near the [[Bilbringi system/Legends|Bilbringi system]] in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]]. The ship was [[Commander/Legends|commanded]] by [[Mak Jorlen]].<ref name="Hero's Trial">''[[The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos I: Hero's Trial]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[The Truce at Bakura]]'', the starship ''[[Flurry]]'' was of this class, but was not specifically identified as such until the release of ''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]''.

In the video game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']], the ''Quasar Fire'' is referred to as the "Alliance escort carrier," and is treated as the equivalent of the standard [[Ton-Falk-class escort carrier|''Ton-Falk''-class escort carrier]], which are only used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Both vessels had identical gameplay value, being able to house six squadrons of starfighters, but were vulnerable from both capital-ship and fighter attacks.
